PHASE.NAME: UPGRADE_2 A2 And A5 Diagnosis And Contract Repair
PHASE.GOAL: Implement structured test failure diagnosis and safe automatic GRACE contract repair.

DATA_FLOWS.FLOW: Failure XML is parsed into assertions, LOG evidence, identifiers, exact matches, and root-cause candidates.
Missing contract failures are converted into dry-run or write-mode contract repair actions and then re-verified.

STEPS.step-1: Create FailureReport parser, identifier extraction, exact search, and EnhancedFixResult.
STEPS.step-2: Create ContractGenerator with language-aware MODULE_CONTRACT, MODULE_MAP, CHANGE_SUMMARY, and function contract generation.
STEPS.step-3: Delegate missing contract failures to RepairContract actions and attach diagnosis evidence.
STEPS.step-4: Expose diagnose_failure and repair_contract handlers with dry_run support.

RISKS.RISK: Contract repair must not duplicate existing contracts or overwrite unrelated source content.
Failure diagnosis must fall back gracefully when XML contains weak or missing location hints.
